summary.en: Register as a voter with Form 6 and receive the Elector's Photo Identity Card.
summary.hi: फ़ॉर्म 6 से मतदाता के रूप में पंजीकरण करें और मतदाता फ़ोटो पहचान पत्र पाएँ।
summary.hn: Form 6 se voter register karein aur Elector's Photo ID Card payein.

text.en: Your name in the electoral roll, and an Elector's Photo Identity Card (EPIC) delivered to your postal address by speed post.
Aged 18 or more on a qualifying date: 1 January, 1 April, 1 July or 1 October. If you turn 18 later in the year you can send an advance Form 6, and it is processed in the quarter you attain the age.
An ordinary resident of the area of the constituency you apply in.
Form 6, addressed to the Electoral Registration Officer of the constituency where you ordinarily live. You can fill it in English or the state's official language.
A recent passport size unsigned colour photo (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm), white background, eyes open, both edges of the face visible.
A self-attested copy of one of the documents listed in the form as age proof, and proof of ordinary residence.
The EPIC is delivered free of cost.
Not stated on the official pages: verify locally.
Fill Form 6 and attach the photo and documents. Apply in the constituency where you ordinarily live.
After enrolment the EPIC is sent to your postal address by speed post against acknowledgement.
